description: Sherry FitzGerald Lettings is proud to present this unfurnished three bedroomed, mid-terrace house discreetly nestled away in this peaceful and tranquil cul-de-sac setting. The property is thoughtfully laid out with an easy flow and well- proportioned rooms. The accommodation comprises of an entrance hall, living room, kitchen/ dining area with sliding patio door opening onto the rear garden and guest W.C. On the upper level there are two double bedrooms (principal bedroom with ensuite), one single and a bathroom. To the front of the property is a cobblelock driveway which provides off-street parking, mature shrubs and an electric car charger. To the rear of the property there is a low maintenance garden, laid out with a large patio area, mature shrubs and a shed. Set in a tranquil idyllic development with extensive landscaped green space. The property is ideally located within easy reach of Dundrum Village, Dundrum Town Centre and still is only a few minutes’ drive to Churchtown and Rathfarnham Villages with its host of eateries, pubs and shops. There is an excellent bus service in the area. There are excellent schools closeby including Rathfarnham Educate Together, Devine Word NS, Gaelcholáiste an Phiarsaigh, Loreto Beaufort and St Mary’s NS to name a few as well as a wide choice of recreational amenities including Airfield, St. Endas Park, Marlay Park and several golf clubs including The Castle and Grange.
